name: Galleonaire
description: Take on the original Galleonaire handheld challenge on iPhone and Apple Watch. Answer fifteen increasingly difficult questions for a fictional million-galleon prize. The original 300-question collection explores magical books and their film adaptations, with explanations and source notes. Use Fifty-Fifty, Ask the Audience and Swap Question, protect your guaranteed prizes, or walk away with your winnings. Both devices support independent offline games, automatic game restoration, native VoiceOver controls, adjustable original music, distinct sound effects and haptics. This is an independent fan-made quiz, not affiliated with or endorsed by the authors, publishers or film studios referenced. Galleons are fictional points with no monetary value. No advertising or analytics.
whatToTest: New Game, How to play and Settings bottom tabs. Answer once to reveal the result immediately: no locking or confirmation. After an answer, VoiceOver should move to the top result and read correct/incorrect, the correct answer and explanation together, followed by Next Question. Check Main Menu after losing or walking away, including after closing and reopening the app. Fifty-Fifty removes two buttons completely. Audience percentages are inside each remaining answer; Swap Question replaces the question at the same prize level. Music and effects now use their full 0-100 percent range, including with VoiceOver, with individual Settings preview buttons for all nine game cues. Listen for clearly different success/failure sounds, audience applause, two Fifty-Fifty pops and the swap effect. Test both devices, large text, audio interruptions, saved games, all prize milestones and paired settings sync. Physical VoiceOver and speaker testing remains important; please report question errors with their source notes.
reviewNotes: No account, password, purchase, advertising or external service is needed to play. Start with New Game. The Watch app is embedded in the iPhone build and is playable independently. In-game galleons are fictional score points, not money, gambling or redeemable prizes. The app does not request Health, contacts, location, microphone or tracking access. Review both visual and native VoiceOver gameplay. Third-party book and film references are inherited trivia content; artwork and audio are original and the app makes no claim of official franchise affiliation.
